note: Single decisions of rAthena's hard monster AI (mob_ai_sub_hard) on an open part of the map, with rnd_force_min. Each case spawns the probe monster at 'center' with mode set to the AI type, level 50 and no monster skills, then runs one call at 5000 ms after the spawn. Offsets dx and dy are from the center. 'player' and 'player2' are players placed on the map with full HP: search: one player ('player_level' 1 is a Novice, 99 a Knight) and mob_ai_sub_hard once. hit: the level 99 player hits the idle monster through mob_set_attacked_id, 'normal' is is_norm_attacked. change: the monster targets 'player' (level 99, dx 1) in 'state' (for attack, ud.target is the player with attack_continue), and 'player2' (level 1) hits it through mob_set_attacked_id. assist: the probe attacks 'player' (level 1, dx 1) through mob_ai_sub_hard, and 'mob2', a second monster of the same ID and AI type, stands at (dx, dy); with 'other_busy' it already targets 'player2' (level 99, dy -5). loot: a Jellopy on the floor at dx, no players. chase: the monster targets the level 99 player in chase state and is not walking. cast: a level 99 Mage at dx starts Fire Bolt level 1 on the monster with unit_skilluse_id, the monster is idle, or chases 'player2' (level 1, dx -1). The result is read before the cast is cancelled. Results: 'target' is md->target_id; 'state' is md->state.skillstate as a mob_skill_db word (attack is berserk, chase is rush); 'aggressive' is md->state.aggressive; 'walking' is whether the walk timer runs, with 'to' the walk destination from the center and 'path_len' the walk path length; 'target_to' is ud.target_to, the unit being chased; 'attack_target' is ud.target and 'attack_continue' ud.state.attack_continue; 'attack_timer' is whether the next attack is scheduled; 'player_hp_lost' is max HP minus HP per player, with delay_battle_damage off so an attack lands at once and the players' perfect dodge (flee2) set to 0; 'players_dead' lists the players the attack killed (a killed target is dropped at once); a dead player is revived before the next case. 'other_target' is mob2's target_id; 'looted' has the loot count and whether the floor item is gone; 'cast_started' is whether the Mage's cast timer runs. Labels: 'self' is the probe, 'mob2' the second monster, 'item' the floor item, 'none' no target, 'other' any other unit.
